title.zh: 从正交方向到矩阵结构
title.en: From Orthogonal Directions to Matrix Structure

description.zh: 从实对称矩阵的正交本征基出发，引入复内积，讨论厄米、幺正与正规矩阵的本征分解。
description.en: Starting from the orthogonal eigenbasis of a real symmetric matrix, we introduce the complex inner product and study eigendecompositions of Hermitian, unitary and normal matrices.

text.en: A set of vectors such as $q_1,q_2$, whose pairwise inner products are zero and whose lengths are one, is called **orthonormal**.

The coefficient $c_i=q_i^{\mathsf T}v$ is the **signed scalar projection** of $v$ onto the direction $q_i$: it is a number that may be positive or negative, whereas the vector component actually lying along that direction is $c_iq_i$. text.zh: 1.3 将投影写成矩阵
text.en: 1.3 Writing the Projections as a Matrix

text.zh: 把 $q_1$、$q_2$ 按列排成 $Q=\begin{bmatrix}q_1&q_2\end{bmatrix}$，乘积 $Q^{\mathsf T}Q$ 的第 $(i,j)$ 个元素正是 $q_i^{\mathsf T}q_j$：
text.en: Arrange $q_1,q_2$ as columns, $Q=\begin{bmatrix}q_1&q_2\end{bmatrix}$. The $(i,j)$ entry of the product $Q^{\mathsf T}Q$ is exactly $q_i^{\mathsf T}q_j$:

text.zh: 对角线给出长度为一，非对角线给出两两正交。若 $Qc=0$，左乘 $Q^{\mathsf T}$ 得 $c=0$，所以 $Q$ 的列线性无关，方阵 $Q$ 可逆。在 $Q^{\mathsf T}Q=I$ 两边右乘 $Q^{-1}$，得到 $Q^{\mathsf T}=Q^{-1}$：正交矩阵的转置就是它的逆。列正交归一的实方阵称为**正交矩阵**。
text.en: The diagonal entries say the lengths are one, and the off-diagonal entries say the columns are pairwise orthogonal. If $Qc=0$, multiplying on the left by $Q^{\mathsf T}$ gives $c=0$, so the columns of $Q$ are linearly independent and the square matrix $Q$ is invertible. Multiplying $Q^{\mathsf T}Q=I$ on the right by $Q^{-1}$ gives $Q^{\mathsf T}=Q^{-1}$: the transpose of an orthogonal matrix is its inverse. A real square matrix with orthonormal columns is called an **orthogonal matrix**.

text.zh: 求坐标因此不必解方程组。由 $c=Q^{\mathsf T}v$，以及 $Sq_1=q_1$、$Sq_2=3q_2$ 按列合写成 $SQ=Q\Lambda$（$\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(1,3)$），右乘 $Q^{\mathsf T}$ 得
text.en: Finding coordinates therefore does not require solving a linear system. We have $c=Q^{\mathsf T}v$, and $Sq_1=q_1$, $Sq_2=3q_2$ combine column by column into $SQ=Q\Lambda$ (with $\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(1,3)$); multiplying on the right by $Q^{\mathsf T}$ gives

tex.zh: Sv=Q\Lambda Q^{\mathsf T}v,\qquad\text{即}\qquad S=Q\Lambda Q^{\mathsf T}.
tex.en: Sv=Q\Lambda Q^{\mathsf T}v,\qquad\text{that is,}\qquad S=Q\Lambda Q^{\mathsf T}.

text.zh: 换基之所以简单，正在于列向量正交归一，逆矩阵可以直接从转置读出。
text.en: The change of basis is simple precisely because the columns are orthonormal, so the inverse can be read off from the transpose.

text.zh: 2.2 长度与正交性的公式需要调整
text.en: 2.2 The Formulas for Length and Orthogonality Need Adjusting

text.zh: 本征值本身是复数时，本征向量一般也是复向量，实平面里“沿本征方向伸缩”的图像不能直接照搬。要把长度与正交重新定义，才能继续讨论正交的本征方向。取
text.en: When an eigenvalue is itself complex, the eigenvector is in general a complex vector too, and the picture of "stretching along an eigendirection" in the real plane cannot be carried over directly. Length and orthogonality must be redefined before we can continue to discuss orthogonal eigendirections. Take

text.zh: 一个非零向量的“长度平方”成为零，原因是转置只换位置、不取共轭，$i^2=-1$ 把正项抵消了。
text.en: so the "squared length" of a nonzero vector becomes zero. The reason is that the transpose only moves entries around without taking conjugates, and $i^2=-1$ cancels the positive term.

text.zh: 把分量先取复共轭再转置，记作 $\dagger$，称为**共轭转置**：
text.en: Taking the complex conjugate of each component and then transposing, denoted $\dagger$, is called the **conjugate transpose**:

text.zh: 其中 $\bar z_k$ 是 $z_k$ 的复共轭。对 $z=(z_1,\dots,z_n)^{\mathsf T}$、$w=(w_1,\dots,w_n)^{\mathsf T}$，定义内积
text.en: where $\bar z_k$ is the complex conjugate of $z_k$. For $z=(z_1,\dots,z_n)^{\mathsf T}$ and $w=(w_1,\dots,w_n)^{\mathsf T}$, define the inner product

text.zh: 它只在第一个向量的分量上多取一次共轭，于是 $\langle z,z\rangle=|z_1|^2+\cdots+|z_n|^2\ge0$，只有 $z=0$ 时为零，据此定义范数 $\|z\|=\sqrt{\langle z,z\rangle}$。回到上面的 $z$，$\|z\|^2=|1|^2+|i|^2=2>0$。
text.en: It conjugates only the components of the first vector, so $\langle z,z\rangle=|z_1|^2+\cdots+|z_n|^2\ge0$, which vanishes only when $z=0$; on this basis the norm is defined as $\|z\|=\sqrt{\langle z,z\rangle}$. Returning to the $z$ above, $\|z\|^2=|1|^2+|i|^2=2>0$.

text.zh: 复内积对两个位置的作用并不对称：
text.en: The complex inner product treats its two slots asymmetrically:

text.zh: 交换两个向量要取共轭：$\langle w,z\rangle=\overline{\langle z,w\rangle}$；

text.zh: 3.1 共轭转置对称带来的性质
text.en: 3.1 Consequences of Conjugate-Transpose Symmetry

text.zh: 满足
text.en: A square matrix satisfying

text.zh: 的方阵称为**厄米矩阵**。逐个元素看，这个条件是 $H_{ij}=\overline{H_{ji}}$：对角元等于自己的共轭，所以是实数；主对角线两侧对应的元素互为共轭。若元素全为实数，这个条件就成为 $H^{\mathsf T}=H$，即实对称。
text.en: is called a **Hermitian matrix**. Entry by entry, this condition is $H_{ij}=\overline{H_{ji}}$: each diagonal entry equals its own conjugate and is therefore real, and entries placed symmetrically across the main diagonal are complex conjugates of each other. If all entries are real, the condition becomes $H^{\mathsf T}=H$, that is, real symmetric.

text.zh: 这个对称条件对本征值和本征向量分别给出限制。
text.en: This symmetry condition constrains the eigenvalues and the eigenvectors respectively.

text.en: The denominator is $x^\dagger x=\|x\|^2>0$. Taking the conjugate of the numerator,

text.en: so the numerator is also real, and $\lambda$ must be real.

text.zh: **不同本征值对应的本征向量正交。** 再设 $Hy=\mu y$，$\lambda\ne\mu$。由于已经证明 $\lambda$ 为实数，
text.en: **Eigenvectors belonging to distinct eigenvalues are orthogonal.** Let also $Hy=\mu y$ with $\lambda\ne\mu$. Since $\lambda$ has been shown to be real,

\lambda x^\dagger y=(Hx)^\dagger y
=x^\dagger H^\dagger y=x^\dagger Hy=\mu x^\dagger y.

text.zh: 因而 $(\lambda-\mu)x^\dagger y=0$，只能有 $x^\dagger y=0$。
text.en: Hence $(\lambda-\mu)x^\dagger y=0$, which forces $x^\dagger y=0$.
